Public work / Line works

Continuous Line XI (yellow)

Year
2026
Series
Continuous Line
Material
9 & 7 inch dia. HDPE corrugated pipe, paint
Size
240 ft of material, installation dimensions variable
Site
Wheaton College, Norton, MA
Status
Temporary

Made with student collaborator Nick Allario ’29 from recyclable industrial drain pipe, which is pliable enough to be shaped intuitively while responding to the architecture and landscape of the site. The color ties the form to Wheaton’s institutional branding as well as to its geometry. One playful “trajectory” among countless others across a campus of pathfinding and trailblazing.
